(Item S-2) Jai Lal vs. State of H.P. and others .

Present: Mr.Tara Singh Chauhan, Senior Advocate with
Mr.Surya Chauhan, Advocate for the petitioner.

Mr.Arsh Rattan, Deputy Advocate General for respondents No.1, 2 and 6.
of Mr.Mukul Sood, Advocate for respondents No.3 to 5.
rt

In the present Public Interest Litigation what has been highlighted during the course of the arguments is that for the winter carnival, short term notice inviting quotations has been given for leasing out the terrace of various areas around the Ridge and Gaiety Theatre for recreational activities for children and women and for installation of temporary stalls w.e.f. 22nd December,
2025 to 31st December, 2025 i.e for 10 days (Annexure P-1).
The tender has been allotted to respondent No.7, who has further subletted the same.

It has been submitted that in pursuance of the same, the food stalls have been installed all over,
leading to blockage of the walking area on the mall road itself and apart from the fact that there are also gas cyclinders being used in impunity and the food stalls are being run without any water connections, causing immense littering and also the food standards are not being checked by any authorities, which is in violation to the Food Safety and .
Standards Act, 2006.

It has also been mentioned that in the designated parking lot, its top floor has been used for setting up stalls on similar basis, leading to traffic jams as of one floor is totally being utilized for the purposes of installation of stalls without caring about the number of rt vehicles used by the tourists which comes during the vacation period, leading to traffic jams.

It has also been brought to our notice that the period is only till 1st January, 2026, but similar issue would again arise when the summer festival will be organized in the month of June and, therefore, it is a repetitive feature and certain guidelines need to be laid down.
Notice.
Mr.Arsh Rattan, learned Deputy Advocate General and Mr.Mukul Sood, Advocate accept notice on behalf of respondents No.1, 2 and 6 and respondents No.3 to 5 respectively.
Dasti notice be issued to respondent No.7, returnable by the next date.

Keeping in view the above, the official respondents shall ensure that there is no blockage of the walk ways on the mall and adjoining road leading to the Ridge due to installation of the stalls and (Item S-2) Jai Lal vs .
